note: Forest roads as models (tools/blender_context/workshop/roads_build.py): points x, z, lane y every 2 m; halfs: lane half width per point; drape: 1 = on the ground + clear, 0 = the crowned section; berms: height, width per point; gaps: s0, s1 (m along); props at s, side (+1 left of the way), off m beyond the lane edge; piles and pads in world x, z (pad gaps: degrees from +z toward +x); junctions: verts x, z, y, tris, the first outline vertices go round the piece, lip 1 where its edge dips into the ground, out the outward direction there; scars: old lines of rerouted road ends (x, z), painted back to snow.
